verdict.rationale: Graphite's AI reviewer applies team conventions to every PR, but only through manually defined custom rules and comment exclusions [graphite-docs-5, graphite-docs-20], plus a general claim of being 'codebase-aware' [graphite-docs-16]. Nothing in the evidence shows it builds a persistent memory or learns automatically from past review decisions. Missing for 10: automatic learning of conventions from past reviews and feedback, a persistent memory store of prior review decisions, and independent corroboration of how custom rules are applied.
